map.距离 = v₀t − ½at²，代入 t=v₀/a 得 v₀²/2a，二者由同一: Distance = v₀t − ½at²; substituting t = v₀/a gives v₀²/2a — both come from the same kinematics.
map.这里的 a 应该怎么取值？: How Should a Be Chosen Here?
map.应填制动时的减速度绝对值。干燥沥青路面一般 7~8 m/s²，湿滑路面可能降到: Enter the absolute deceleration during braking. Dry asphalt is typically 7–8 m/s², wet slippery surfaces may drop to 3–4 m/s², and ice or snow is lower still. A wrong value significantly skews the result, so for safety assessment use the worst-case surface.
